title: Alignment signal kit and decision tracker
body:
Purpose

Short kit for leaders to standardize the mid-year cascade, prepare a tight all-team update, and capture decisions as they happen. Treat this as the single source for: (a) what we commit to publicly at the all-hands, (b) who owns follow-ups, and (c) a lightweight decision register we can point to in exec syncs.

TL;DR (for execs)
- Theme proposal for all-hands: 'Serve Better, Ship Faster' — emphasize reliability and predictable economics as our product differentiator.
- Top company OKR candidates (draft): improve 99th pct latency SLO, reduce token unit cost by 18% across hosted workloads, onboard 8 Dedicated customers to committed capacity, and launch Private beta with 2 regulated customers.
- Immediate ask to leads: pick owner for each KR by EOD Fri, prepare 2 slides max for all-hands (status + risks + one ask).

Audience and scope
- Audience: all employees + board watchers. Tone: concise, engineering-friendly, operations-forward.
- Scope: company-level OKRs + cross-functional rollups (Eng, Product, DevExp, SRE, Sales). Technical detail should live in product/eng breakouts, not the all-hands deck.

All-hands runbook (compact)
- 0:00–0:03 Intro (CEO) — 1 slide: theme + headline metric(s)
- 0:03–0:12 State of product & platform (Head of Product + Head of Infra) — 3 slides: progress on latency/cost, Dedicated traction, Private readiness
- 0:12–0:20 Customer story + demo (Customer Success + Solutions Eng) — 2 slides + short video snippet (30s)
- 0:20–0:28 Org commitments & hires (People Ops + Eng leaders) — 2 slides: hiring pivot and where the headcount will go
- 0:28–0:35 Rollouts & next 90-day bets (Product ops) — 3 slides: rollout windows, canary plans, and risk mitigations
- 0:35–0:45 Q&A (moderated) — keep backlog for follow-ups; capture in decision log

Slide guidance (for submitters)
- Max 2 slides per speaker. Each slide: 1 headline, 3 bullets (no more), 1 explicit ask (if any). Bullet examples: "We will reduce 99p latency from 420ms to 320ms by Q4 (owner: J. Singh)"

Draft company-level OKR cascade (v0.1)
Objective A: Deliver predictable, industry-leading inference latency and reliability
- KR A1: Reduce 99th percentile token generation latency (hosted-api) from 420ms -> 320ms (owner: Jordan Singh)
- KR A2: Increase platform uptime to 99.95% across hosted and Dedicated regions (owner: Priya Rao)
- KR A3: Implement cross-region fallback routing for top 5 customer routes (owner: SRE team lead)

Objective B: Improve unit economics for customer workloads
- KR B1: Reduce per-token cost on common inference profiles by 18% through batching + quant recommendations (owner: Model Ops)
- KR B2: Ship Redwood Optimize pilot with 3 customers and measure 10% average cost reduction (owner: Optimize PM)

Objective C: Grow predictable revenue via Dedicated and Private offerings
- KR C1: Convert 8 customers to Dedicated reserved capacity contracts (owner: Sales AE lead)
- KR C2: Launch Private beta with 2 regulated customers (owner: Private Deployments PM)

Notes on the cascade
- These KRs are intentionally aggressive; we expect teams to break KRs down to rollout milestones. Owners should create 4-week checkpoints in Jira (JIRA-PLAT-1234 is the template).
- If a KR is ownerless by Fri, escalate at Monday exec sync.

Decision tracker (living log)
- 2025-06-10 | Decided: Theme 'Serve Better, Ship Faster' selected for all-hands | Owner: Maya Rodriguez | Rationale: clarifies product + ops play, aligns to customer conversations | Follow-up: comms deck to reflect theme (owner: Asha)
- 2025-06-12 | Decided: Defer public 90-day hiring targets to 1:1s with managers | Owner: People Ops | Rationale: avoid surprise in town; provide contextual plan in manager kit | Follow-up: manager kit due 2025-06-18 (owner: Noah)
- 2025-06-15 | Decided: Default latency target set to 99p for Hosted API only (for Q3) | Owner: Head of Infra | Rationale: Dedicated has different SLOs, keep metric simple for company audience | Follow-up: infra to prepare dashboard for all-hands (owner: Priya)

Quick comms checklist (pre-all-hands)
- [ ] Execs confirm slides (2 slides max) — owners: all execs — due: 2025-06-22
- [ ] Release notes + customer-facing summary drafted — owner: comms — due: 2025-06-24
- [ ] Slack announcement + RSVP channel created (#all-hands) — owner: Internal comms — due: 2025-06-24
- [ ] Q&A backlog triage plan (who answers what) — owner: Product ops — due: 2025-06-25

Open questions / tensions (call these out early)
- Do we fold Dedicated and Private metrics into single company dashboard? Pro: simpler company message. Con: hides variability and could confuse sales comps. (Proposed: highlight headline metric + link to per-product dashboards).
- Risk: shipping Optimize pilot too broadly will dilute measurement. Proposed guardrail: pilot limited to customers with >500M tokens/mo. Owner: Optimize PM.
- Should we announce pricing moves publicly at all-hands? Recommendation: no — use all-hands for product and roadmap, coordinate pricing communications separately with sales and customers.

Post all-hands follow-up template (to send in #all-hands)
- Headline recap (1 paragraph)
- Slides + recording link
- Decision log summary with owners and due dates (link to this doc)
- Action items and owners with Jira tasks attached

Next steps (short horizon)
- By 2025-06-20: owners confirmed on all KRs, slides submitted in Google Slides folder. (owners: execs)
- By 2025-06-24: comms draft ready for review with legal check. (owner: Comms lead)
- Weekly: decision log updated in Monday exec sync; Maya to own consolidation.

Notes to self (work-in-progress)
- Need a one-pager for managers that explains what to say in team-level standups after the all-hands. Keep it <150 words.
- Consider a short internal survey post all-hands to capture clarity and follow-up requests (two quick questions).

References and links
- Confluence: "Company OKR template" — conf:PLAT-482
- Jira: use PLAT epic for OKR breakdowns (JIRA-PLAT-1234)
- Slack channels: #all-hands, #eng-announce, #product-updates

End of kit.

-- maya
